notes: All 12 source IDs and 19 target tokens are partitioned exactly once. Both temporal cola are divided alike under rule 52: the preposition takes the subordinator (*While*, *while*), the suffix takes the subject pronoun, and the noun or adverb carries the recast predicate.
The reversed glosses on s011/s012 are a display defect; MACULA's morphology (`D` on `עוֹד`, `Sp1cs` on the suffix) governs, as the accepted alignment reads it (rule 39).

A competing reading of *have any being* was considered and set aside: rule 43's suffix clause (`טוֹבָתִי בַּל עָלֶיךָ` → *I have no good*) would give the suffix *I have* headed on the pronoun and leave `עוֹד` only *any being*. The accepted division keeps the *have* inside the noun's recast predicate, parallel to the first colon's `חַיִּים` → *live*, where the suffix likewise takes only the subject pronoun rule 52 gives it. Both are defensible; this note records the alternative under rule 8.

The head of `זָמַר` → *I will sing praises* stays on *sing* rather than moving to *praises* under rule 44: `זָמַר` is the singing itself, so *sing* is not a light verb whose complement carries the lexeme.
